name: hsyn_initialize
comment: modhsyn ordinal4. Store update scale=(interval<<8)/1000; SNDBASE supplies1047 hex. Initialize each nonnull port to base priority0,quota48,count0,mode0 and16 channels; initialize two24-slot cores; status refresh1. Module-relative; live base unknown.

name: hsyn_check_reversed_section_tags
type: int hsyn_check_reversed_section_tags(unsigned int magic, unsigned int section, char *magic_tag, char *section_tag)
comment: Check both serialized four-byte words against reverse byte order of literal validation tags. IECS/sreV and IECS/daeH etc accepted.

name: hsyn_load_bank
type: int hsyn_load_bank(void *module, int port, unsigned int spu_base, unsigned char *header, unsigned int bank_index)
comment: modhsyn export ordinal 6, matching SNDBASE hsyn_load import. Module-relative ELF coordinates; fixed live IOP base unknown. Bind a 0x1C bank row: Head=header+0x10; Prog/Sset/Smpl/Vagi/Setb from Head offsets +0x14/+0x18/+0x1C/+0x20/+0x24 relative to header; last word SPU base. Bank index 0..15; context mode byte+3=1 aliases bank zero. Validate reverse-byte SCEI/section tags; clear channel program bindings referencing replaced bank.

name: hsyn_initialize_channel
comment: Initialize three channel voice-list sentinels (held at channel-8,sustained at channel,released at channel+8), clear program/bank pointers, sustain+32=0, controls and overrides.

name: hsyn_select_program
type: void hsyn_select_program(unsigned char *port_state, unsigned char *channel, unsigned int program)
comment: C0 program selection. channel+0x2A selects bank row at port_state+0x384+bank*0x1C; row+4 is Prog. Require program byte<=section+0x0C and offset[program]!=-1; pointer=Prog+offset. Program+4 split count zero clears program. Retain program at channel+0x18 and bank at +0x20.

name: hsyn_dispatch_short_command
type: void hsyn_dispatch_short_command(unsigned char *port, unsigned int port_index, unsigned int status, unsigned char first, unsigned char second)
comment: Low status nibble selects 0x38-byte channel. C0 binds program; 90 calls note-on with key=first, velocity=second or note-off at velocity zero; 80 note-off; B0 controls; E0 pitch bend.

name: hsyn_dispatch_extended_command
type: void hsyn_dispatch_extended_command(unsigned char *port, unsigned int port_index, unsigned char status, unsigned char *payload)
comment: F9 consumes four payload bytes; FD six. FD10 payload is subcommand, channel, key, tag, velocity, trailing byte. Channel low nibble; channel bit4 restores key high bit, then note path masks key to seven bits. Zero velocity calls note-off(key,tag); nonzero calls hsyn_note_on(key,velocity,tag). Trailing byte is unused in FD10. F9 01 writes channel pan byte; F9 02 writes 14-bit pitch field.

name: hsyn_decode_compact_packet
type: void hsyn_decode_compact_packet(unsigned char *port, unsigned int port_index, unsigned char *begin, unsigned char *end)
comment: Bounded compact packet decoder. Skip unmarked data bytes; short status lengths from table; F9 advances five total bytes, FD seven; incomplete commands return without dispatch. Calls short and extended dispatchers.

name: hsyn_drain_port_packets
comment: Read pairs of input/context entries. Packet payload begin=input+8, end=begin+input_length; clear length before dispatch. Port mode byte+2 bit0=0 selects compact decoder; bit0=1 selects separate FE-prefixed scheduled decoder.

name: hsyn_main
comment: Ordinal5: refresh reserved mix masks; drain packets across port order; dispatch staged (flush key-off before starts,key-on afterward); update active. Pressure-reclaim disables second status read that call; updater restores eligibility. Optional diagnostics deferred/retained counts. Module-relative; live base unknown.

name: hsyn_reserve_voice_masks
comment: Export8: supplied per-core bitmasks remove currently free corresponding slots into reserved lists and lower free counts; restore previous reserved slots first. Store masks used by main to preserve externally managed mix bits.

name: hsyn_decode_scheduled_packet
type: void hsyn_decode_scheduled_packet(unsigned char *port, unsigned int port_index, unsigned char *begin, unsigned char *end)
comment: Separate decoder selected by port mode byte+2 bit0=1. FE-prefixed timestamped records; distinct from plain C0/F9/FD compact fighter packets.

name: hsyn_initialize_voice_pool
comment: Initialize two cores of24 voice records, stride150, core/slot indices40/41; link every record to core free list and set free count24. Clear active/staged/reserved lists and key/mix masks.

name: hsyn_link_global_voice
comment: Insert voice global links+0/+4 at doubly-linked list head.

name: hsyn_unlink_global_voice
comment: Unlink voice global links+0/+4.

name: hsyn_link_channel_voice
comment: Insert voice channel links+8/+C at doubly-linked sentinel list head.

name: hsyn_unlink_channel_voice
comment: Unlink voice channel links+8/+C.

name: hsyn_dispatch_staged_voices
comment: Per core0 then1 flush pending KOFF selector1600 first; defer mode+57=1/keyFF or ENVX>999; mode+59=0 starts sampled voice,1 alternate. Move started voice global staged->active; flush KON selector1500. Return deferred count.

name: hsyn_initialize_selected_voice
comment: Initialize selected voice from retained program/split/sample records; VAG+4 ushort is sample rate and contributes pitch normalization by 48000. Does not select PLVOICE archive members.

name: hsyn_start_selected_voice
comment: Port mode0 starter: VAG+SPU base ->selector2040; sample gain/pitch/ADSR/mix; Smpl+29 bits1/2/4/8 route dry/wet L/R; stage KON; initialize startup grace+4B=3; clear pending flag8. No PLVOICE lookup.

name: hsyn_update_voice_pitch
comment: Combine modulation,portamento,ramp,program/split/sample pitch and VAG rate scale; emit selector200 only on changed cached value.

name: hsyn_update_voice_volume
comment: Combine voice gain,port gain,modulation,pan/ramp; clamp3FFF, update cached left/right volume and libsd selectors0/100 only when changed.

name: hsyn_update_active_voices
comment: After staged dispatch; if status-refresh enabled read ENDX/ENVX. flags&300=0 recycle at ENVX0; held/sustained need ENDX and ENVX0 after startup grace. Grace+4B initially3: ENDX set decrements, clear resets0; protected read reports7FFF. Otherwise one pitch/volume/modulation/portamento/ramp step. Restore status-refresh eligibility1.

name: hsyn_reclaim_finished_voices
comment: Pressure sweep once while status-refresh flag set; cache ENVX+12. Reclaim flags&300=0 at ENVX0; held/sustained also need ENDX and expired startup grace. Return any recycled.

name: hsyn_initialize_portamento
comment: Key delta sets signed pitch accumulator voice+38 and flags2/4; per-update step+2A=abs(delta*800)*update_scale/channel+24 >>8. Active updater moves accumulator toward0 once/call.

name: hsyn_start_alternate_voice
comment: Port mode1 starter uses alternate record pitch/ADSR/mix but same VAG address and KON staging; initializes grace+4B=3 and clears pending flag8.

name: hsyn_note_off
comment: Held channel list matches key+43/tag+44 (FF wildcard). Unlink/clear flags300. Sustain+32 nonzero sets100/relinks sustained. Else started voice releases modulation,KOFF/relinks released; flags8 unstarted recycles immediately. Started slot count retained until recycle.

name: hsyn_recycle_unstarted_voice
comment: Called for flags8 (allocated/staged, not started); both starters clear8. Immediate recycle without hardware key-off: caller unlinks channel; clear flags/counts, unlink global, increment core free count/relink free list, clear tag/mode.

name: hsyn_set_channel_sustain
comment: Nonzero controller sets sustain+32; zero after sustain releases sustained list: clear flags300,key-off/relink started voices to released; flags8 unstarted recycle.

name: hsyn_release_channel_notes
comment: Release all held/sustained voices: clear flags300,key-off/relink started voices to released; flags8 unstarted recycle.

name: hsyn_recycle_voice
comment: Detach channel/global lists; decrement owning port/mode count; increment core free count and relink free list. Clear flags/tag/mode/modulation. Hardware key-off/envelope is caller responsibility.

name: hsyn_enforce_port_voice_limit
comment: At quota scan channel released lists first, min priority <= incoming; if none scan held/sustained lists. <= replaces equal ties. Key-off/force envelope/recycle chosen voice;0 means note_on returns, abandoning remaining candidates.

name: hsyn_note_on
type: void hsyn_note_on(unsigned char *port, unsigned char *channel, unsigned char port_index, unsigned char key, unsigned char velocity, unsigned int tag)
comment: Program+0 split-list offset relative to program; +4 byte split count, stride0x14. Split+0 ushort Sset id, key range bytes+2/+4 masked0x7F. Sset row byte+1/+2 velocity min/max,+3 sample count, ushort sample ids+4. Smpl+0 ushort Vagi id, velocity bounds bytes+2/+4 masked0x7F. Prog/Sset/Smpl/Vagi tables have inclusive maximum index+0x0C and offsets+0x10 relative to each section; -1 holes skipped. Walk all matching splits/samples; allocator admission can prevent voices. Retain program/split/sample/VAG at voice+0x64/+0x68/+0x6C/+0x70, SPU bank base+0x74. VAG out-of-range produces null VAG pointer/noise branch; in-range holes or VAG address -1 skip.

name: hsyn_take_free_voice
comment: Smpl+29 mask10=>core0,20=>core1; otherwise larger free count, ties core0. Empty returns0; else decrement count/unlink free head.

name: hsyn_steal_active_voice
comment: Mask10/20 filters cores, zero admits both; core1 then0 active lists, mode+57=0. Ascending flags&300, priority+14 <= incoming, then cached ENVX+12 (strict ties). Unlink, decrement owner/global counts, key-off; clear flags/tag/mode.

name: hsyn_steal_staged_voice
comment: After active stealing fails scan allowed cores1 then0 staged lists, mode+57=0; smallest priority <= incoming, strict comparison retains first tie. Unlink/count decrement/clear slot.

name: hsyn_choke_channel_group
comment: Nonzero sample+0E group scans held/sustained/released channel lists matching voice+49. Started voice key-off/force ADSR2=C021/recycle; flags8 unstarted channel-unlink/recycle. Before quota/slot allocation.

name: hsyn_step_modulation
comment: One update step for modulation state1..5: delay counter decreases once; phase advances by increment plus optional ramp; attack/release amplitude advances once, terminal state6 yields0.

name: hsyn_initialize_modulation
comment: Use update scale to convert delay/ramp/period to ticks: duration units *256 rounded by scale/2 then /scale, ramp increment65536/ticks (min1 for nonzero ramp). Program sample modulation selectors choose active records.

name: hsyn_release_modulation
comment: Release active modulation to delay4/ramp5/terminal6; inactive unchanged.

name: hsyn_set_spu_parameter
comment: Optional command log then libsd ordinal5 parameter write; selectors300/400 ADSR1/2; port eviction/choke writes selector400 valueC021.

name: hsyn_get_spu_parameter
comment: Optional command log then libsd ordinal6 parameter read; selector500 is voice ENVX.

name: hsyn_get_spu_switch
comment: Optional command log then libsd ordinal8 switch read; selector1700 is ENDX.

name: hsyn_set_spu_address
comment: Pass libsd address selector and uint32 value through optional command log, then imported libsd ordinal9. Called by hsyn_start_selected_voice with selector0x2040 and SPU bank base plus VAG sample offset.

name: hsyn_export_table
comment: modhsyn IOP export table: ordinal5 hsyn_main,6 hsyn_load_bank,7 voice transfer; embedded image's relocatable export pointers establish qualified-symbol correspondence to SNDBASE imports.

name: hsyn_bank_section_tags
comment: Validation tags SCEI,Vers,Head,Prog,Sset,Smpl,Vagi,Setb; bank file stores each four-character word reversed as IECS,sreV,daeH,gorP,tesS,lpmS,igaV,bteS.

name: hsyn_update_scale
comment: Configured update scale=(interval_argument<<8)/1000; SNDBASE1047 hex yields1066. Used to convert authored delay/ramp/period fields to per-update steps.

name: hsyn_status_refresh_available
comment: Init/update sets1; first pressure-reclaim sweep clears0, suppressing repeated hardware completion reads until end of active update.

name: hsyn_core_free_voice_counts
comment: Initialized24 per core; reserve/free/allocation helpers update counts.
